content: {"phoneNote":"The apothecary label card in the hero is charming and fits the trade well, though the primary green button looks broken with its left-aligned underlined text.","desktopNote":"The hero composition with the double-bordered card and arched photo is distinctive and atmospheric, though the product cards further down feel a bit sparse without product photos or descriptions.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"fixes":["Center the text inside the primary green CTA button ('Poglejte izbor izdelkov'), remove its underline, and add horizontal padding on desktop so the text doesn't touch the button edges.","Add a short one-line description or weight/volume detail inside the three product cards ('Iz naše trgovinice') to reduce the empty space between the title and price.","Enlarge the header logo slightly and add location/hours or a contact link in the top right on desktop to balance the empty white header bar."],"blockers":[]}
